name: Voice Agent Booking API with Slot Engine

parameters.content:
## Voice Agent Booking API with Slot Engine

One webhook that gives a phone agent three tools: offer open times, book one,
and cancel. It works with VAPI, Retell or a plain POST, because the request
reader handles all three shapes. Every reply comes back as a sentence the agent
can read out, plus structured fields for logging.

### How it works

The caller is on the line, so availability is worked out in code rather than by
letting a model browse a calendar. A small model does one narrow job: turning
"sometime next week, mornings" into a date window. The slot engine then reads
your Business Hours tab, pulls the calendar's busy events for that window, and
builds candidate slots that respect opening hours, slot length, a gap between
appointments, a daily booking cap, a minimum notice period, blackout dates and
the caller's morning or afternoon preference. It returns the first three that
survive, with a spoken phrasing for each. Booking is conflict safe: the slot is
checked again at the moment of booking, so two callers racing for the same time
cannot both get it, and the second one is told the time has just gone. A short
reference is derived from the slot and phone number, so a retried call produces
the same reference instead of a duplicate. Cancellation looks the reference up,
removes the calendar event and marks the row cancelled.

### Setup

Connect Calendar, Sheets and your model credential. Set the calendar and sheet
IDs, fill the Business Hours tab with one row per weekday, and create the
Appointments tab. Point your voice agent's tool at the webhook URL.

### Customization

Change the slot length, buffer and daily cap per weekday in the sheet, with no
edits to the workflow.

## Read the tool call, pick a lane
VAPI, Retell and a plain POST all look different. One code node reads all three, then the switch sends the call to find slots, book or cancel.

## Turn spoken time into dates
The model does one narrow job: resolving words like tomorrow or next Tuesday morning into a date window and a part of day.

## Work out what is actually open
Business hours, slot length, buffer between appointments, daily cap, minimum notice and blackout dates are all applied in code. Three slots come back with spoken phrasing.

## Book without double booking
The slot is checked again at the moment of booking, so two callers cannot take the same time. The reference is derived from the slot, so a retry does not create a second booking.

## Cancel by reference
The caller reads back their reference. The row is found, the calendar event removed and the status set to cancelled.

options.systemMessage:
You convert a spoken request for an appointment time into a date window.

Today is {{ $now.format('yyyy-MM-dd') }}, a {{ $now.format('EEEE') }}.

Rules
- Resolve relative words against today's date: tomorrow, next week, Monday, the day after tomorrow.
- Return startDate and endDate as plain YYYY-MM-DD. For a single named day both are the same date.
- A vague request such as "sometime next week" becomes that week's Monday to Friday.
- A request with no time detail at all becomes today through seven days ahead.
- partOfDay is one of morning, afternoon, evening or any. Only set it when the caller actually said so.
- Never return a startDate in the past. If the caller named a day that has already passed this week, use next week's.
- interpreted is one short sentence describing what you understood, for the call log.

Return only the requested JSON fields.
